entry.title: Poultry House — Yasnaya Polyana

groundCutout.basis: Only occupied hut footprint; original approaches and neighboring shed remain.

buildingCutout.basis: Two adjacent retained one-story shed footprints are candidates for the small gray-gabled poultry house and longer red-hipped equipment shed shown together in the ordinary museum photograph. Sizes and separation support this assignment. The retained long axes are nearly parallel; the photograph may show different faces through perspective/parallax, and no camera position is known. Specific poultry/equipment function and absolute front assignment remain explicit photo/relative-context inferences; the public map names both only as sheds. Use the photographed gray roof on the small building despite the generic map red-roof tag. This small mapped footprint supplies8.46x5.72m scale; localX southeast is the inferred door/window gable. Its mapped neighbor remains independent. Source axes are baked east/up/south, heading0.

terrainReference.basis: Retained Protomaps20261020 and standard Mapzen201x201/6m terrain. Outside control[6.198225021976045,0] gives215.71102437248442m datum. Preserve original DEM samples, the separate neighboring equipment shed, paths and all pond geometry. Replace only building35184539471089 and cut only its occupied footprint. Solid steps seat into native ground without flattening or broad yard cuts; exact historic levels/accessibility are reconstructed.
